findings.issue: The feature 'Location tracking: For fraud prevention, the app tracks the user's location continuously while the credit line is active.' violates the requirement that data collection by DLA and DLA of LSP must be need-based and with prior and explicit consent of the borrower having audit trail. findings.fix: Modify the location tracking feature to ensure it is need-based, with prior and explicit consent from the borrower. Maintain an audit trail of all data collection activities as required by DLD2025:12(i).

summary: The compliance review of the FlexLine: Revolving Credit Line App identified several critical non-compliance issues with the reviewed RBI rules. The product feature fails to provide contact details of the nodal grievance redressal officers in the KFS, violating DLD2025:11(ii). Additionally, the app does not send digitally signed documents to the borrower via email or SMS, which contradicts DLD2025:8(iii). Lastly, the feature of continuous location tracking for fraud prevention violates DLD2025:12(i) as it lacks explicit consent and is not need-based. These findings highlight significant gaps in compliance with the RBI regulations.
